Resolve the upstream engineering issue below. Work in this checkout using the preprovisioned dependencies. The bash tool executes PowerShell 7 with no profile inside an isolated Windows filesystem; external networking is disabled. You may change production code, public tests and documentation. Preserve package metadata, dependency locks, configuration, native-verify.cjs, verification.json and .v4-* verification helpers. Do not install packages or attempt to access other workspaces. Run node native-verify.cjs for the repository-derived public smoke suite; you may run it with --tests-json PATH to test other existing public unit files. Independent grading reconstructs production changes in a pristine checkout and applies held-out upstream tests. Existing public snapshots may predate the requested behavior; do not undo that behavior merely to satisfy old snapshots.

Better cache handling of multiple (but different) prettier calls
**Environments:**
- Prettier Version: 2.7.0
- Running Prettier via: CLI
- Operating System: Windows

After discussion https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/12800#discussion_r867309015 you moved from default cache location `.prettiercache` (eslint style) to `node_modules/.cache/prettier` (ava style).

In https://github.com/prettier/prettier/pull/12800#discussion_r878056060 you needed a use case for a `--cache-location` CLI param.

I have a script which formats and compiles many Visual Studio projects which shares one `node_modules` dir.
Compiling one project boosts the prettier call from 15s to 2s. 🎉

But every project has different files (surprise :-) so every prettier call finds new files and rebuilds (!) `node_modules/.cache/prettier` from scratch (which renders the cache useless in many situations).

It would be better if prettier would
* expand the cached cache file with new found files (but when do we cleanup?) or
* default to `.prettiercache` to be able to have a cache file per vs project or
* readd  `--cache-location` CLI param so I can configure the cache in my build script


cc @sosukesuzuki @fisker @7rulnik

const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),{spawnSync}=require('child_process');
const root=process.cwd(),config=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('verification.json','utf8')),args=process.argv.slice(2);
const value=name=>{const index=args.indexOf(name);return index<0?undefined:args[index+1];};
const report=path.resolve(value('--report')||'.v4-tmp/public-report.json');fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(report),{recursive:true});
const selected=value('--tests-json'),tests=selected?JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(selected,'utf8')):config.publicTests;
const env={...process.env,CI:'true',TZ:'UTC',NODE_ENV:'test',NODE_OPTIONS:'--max-old-space-size=384',SUFFICE_EVAL_REPORT:report};
const execute=(argv,timeout=240000)=>spawnSync(config.nodeRuntime,['--max-old-space-size=384',...argv],{cwd:root,env,encoding:'utf8',windowsHide:true,timeout,maxBuffer:16*1024**2});
for(const build of config.buildSteps){
  const result=execute(build,120000);if(result.stdout)process.stdout.write(result.stdout);if(result.stderr)process.stderr.write(result.stderr);
  if(result.status!==0){fs.writeFileSync(report,JSON.stringify({framework:config.framework,executionFailure:{stage:'build',code:result.status,signal:result.signal,error:result.error?.message,launchErrorCode:result.error?.code,stdout:result.stdout,stderr:result.stderr}}));process.exit(result.status||1);}
}
let invocation;
if(config.framework==='mocha')invocation=['node_modules/mocha/bin/_mocha',...(config.mochaRequires??[]).flatMap(name=>['--require',name]),...tests,'--reporter',path.resolve('.v4-mocha-reporter.cjs'),'--timeout','15000','--exit'];
else if(config.framework==='jest')invocation=['node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js','--runInBand','--watchman=false','--json','--outputFile',report,'--no-cache','--runTestsByPath',...tests];
else if(config.framework==='qunit')invocation=['.v4-qunit-runner.cjs',config.qunitEntry];
else throw new Error('Unknown verified framework');
const result=execute(invocation);if(result.stdout)process.stdout.write(result.stdout);if(result.stderr)process.stderr.write(result.stderr);
if(!fs.existsSync(report))fs.writeFileSync(report,JSON.stringify({framework:config.framework,executionFailure:{stage:'test',code:result.status,signal:result.signal,error:result.error?.message,launchErrorCode:result.error?.code,stdout:result.stdout,stderr:result.stderr}}));
if(result.error)process.stderr.write('\n'+result.error.message+'\n');
console.log('\nVerification report: '+path.relative(root,report));process.exit(result.status??1);

Implemented `--cache-location` to let independent formatting runs use separate cache files.

- Supports relative and absolute cache-file paths.
- Preserves the existing default cache location.
- Requires `--cache`.
- Adds documentation and regression tests for separate caches with both `content` and `metadata` strategies.

Example:
```sh
prettier --write --cache --cache-location .prettiercache src
```

- Public smoke suite: **20 tests passed**
- Cache integration suite: **18 tests passed**
- Formatting check and `git diff --check`: **passed**
